title: Azure Compute Options: Control vs Ops

scenes.line1: How would you host your app?
scenes.say: You need to host an app in Azure. Which compute option should you pick—and why?

rows.b: Full OS control, you patch all

scenes.say: From most control to least ops: start with virtual machines, then scale sets, Kubernetes, Container Apps, App Service, and finally Functions for event-driven tasks.

scenes.label: ACI
scenes.sub: Single container jobs, no autoscale or load balancer
scenes.say: Azure Container Instances are for single or batch containers. No built-in load balancer or autoscale—so not for production web apps.
In interviews, start with the most managed option that fits. Only step down to VMs if you need more control. Always justify your choice.

scenes.question: Is ACI good for a prod web app?
scenes.wrong: Yes, it's a great web tier.
scenes.right: No—ACI lacks autoscale and load balancing. Use App Service or Container Apps instead.
scenes.say: Don't trip up: Azure Container Instances aren't meant for production web apps. They miss key features like autoscale and load balancing.
